files.deploy/k8s/cleanup-cron.yaml:
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: CronJob
metadata: { name: cleanup-cron }
spec:
  schedule: "0 * * * *"
  jobTemplate:
    spec:
      template:
        spec:
          containers:
            - name: cleanup
              image: registry.example.com/shop/tools:1.0.0
              args: ["psql", "-c", "DELETE FROM sessions WHERE expires_at < now()"]
          restartPolicy: OnFailure
files.deploy/k8s/archiver.yaml:
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: CronJob
metadata: { name: archiver }
spec:
  schedule: "0 3 * * *"
  jobTemplate:
    spec:
      template:
        spec:
          containers:
            - name: archiver
              image: registry.example.com/shop/tools:1.0.0
              args: ["archive-sessions"]
          restartPolicy: OnFailure

message: k8s: delete cleanup-cron; it raced the nightly archiver and purged unarchived rows (INC-2023-02). Cleanup now runs inside the archiver.

files.deploy/k8s/archiver.yaml:
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: CronJob
metadata: { name: archiver }
spec:
  schedule: "0 3 * * *"
  jobTemplate:
    spec:
      template:
        spec:
          containers:
            - name: archiver
              image: registry.example.com/shop/tools:1.1.0
              args: ["archive-sessions", "--then-cleanup"]
          restartPolicy: OnFailure
files.docs/postmortems/INC-2023-02.md:
# INC-2023-02: unarchived sessions purged

The hourly cleanup cron deleted expired sessions before the nightly archiver had copied them. 3 days of audit data lost. The cron was deleted; cleanup now runs inside the archiver after the copy. Do not add a separate cleanup job.
